query: INSERT INTO cqrs_snapshots (stream_type, stream_id, revision, version, state) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (stream_type, stream_id) DO UPDATE SET revision = EXCLUDED.revision, version = EXCLUDED.version, state = EXCLUDED.state WHERE cqrs_snapshots.version < EXCLUDED.version OR cqrs_snapshots.revision <> EXCLUDED.revision
